name: Good Practice (3-player)
description: The full 3-player Dragon rules, rule set v0.3 (decision 0016, docs/RULES.md): every 3-player parameter at its default. Shown as Good Practice. Experimental until bot self-play shows the seats are balanced.
notes: Played before S68 built coast.3p.exit, so every Coast piece could leave the Coast with any legal move. Kept with a lock (any-legal-move) so its games and fairness reports replay as they were played (decision 0019).
